overflow-y-auto"><div><p><strong>TL;DR</strong><br />
<a href="https://www.greenlite.ai/">Greenlite</a> helps fintechs unlock growth with an AI compliance team.</p>
<p>Our workforce of AI agents tirelessly handle routine AML and KYC tasks, allowing your team to focus on higher-leverage work.</p>
<p>If you’re a fintech or compliance leader, get in touch at <a href="mailto:founders@greenlite.ai">founders@greenlite.ai</a>.</p>
<h2 id="problem"><strong>Problem</strong></h2>
<p>Fintech compliance teams <strong>spend millions of dollars on manual anti-money laundering (AML) and know-your-customer (KYC) reviews</strong>. To support customer growth, fintechs turn to outsourced analysts or consultants to complete these reviews.  The workflows assigned to outsourced teams are routine, clearly-defined and require risk-based decisions to be escalated to a full-time employee (FTE).</p>
<p><strong>Managing outsourced analysts is painful and expensive.</strong> Training takes months, quality assurance is a challenge and any additional tooling/automation needs to be built by your internal engineering teams.</p>
<p><strong>Critically, the productivity of these AML teams are low</strong>. <a href="https://www.mckinsey.com/capabilities/risk-and-resilience/our-insights/the-investigator-centered-approach-to-financial-crime-doing-what-matters">McKinsey estimated</a> that as little as 15% of an AML investigator’s time is spent actually investigating. Manual processes, administrative tasks and limited working hours leave backlogs to grow, increasing risks of a major fine.</p>
<h3 id="solution"><strong>Solution</strong></h3>
<p><a href="https://www.greenlite.ai/">Greenlite</a>’s AI agents learn your alert review process and work 24/7 to complete entry-level KYC and AML tasks.</p>
<p>They pair language models and 200+ data sources to action false positives, investigate high-risk customers and create audit-ready narratives. </p>
<p>Suspicious activity is escalated to your FTEs, allowing you to be in control of risk based decisions.</p>
<h2 id="here-s-how-it-works"><strong>Here’s how it works</strong></h2>
<h3 id="choose-where-you-need-staff-augmentation">Choose where you need staff augmentation</h3>
<p>Greenlite supports three agent archetypes (with more to come). Each one can learn your company’s specific workflows to handle routine cases.</p>
<p><img src="/media/?type=post&id=72627&key=user_uploads%2F1152966%2F7d2bc16b-7e94-41f7-8bd4-4ef467c09b8c&variant=large" alt="uploaded image" /></p>
<h3 id="add-your-policy-data-sources-and-fuzziness-thresholds">Add your policy, data sources and fuzziness thresholds</h3>
<p>Upload your workflow policy, define the data sources that are needed for this job and determine the fuzziness threshold you’re comfortable with.</p>
<p><img src="/media/?type=post&id=72627&key=user_uploads%2F1152966%2F55090200-1b67-4d7f-ae1d-e21c04863a24&variant=large" alt="uploaded image" /></p>
<h3 id="review-escalated-cases">Review escalated cases</h3>
<p>Agents will escalate cases that require a risk based decision. Importantly, your FTEs get an enriched case, complete with entity investigation details, data analysis and open-source intelligence to make high quality decisions more efficiently.</p>
<p><img src="/media/?type=post&id=72627&key=user_uploads%2F1152966%2F07dccab8-c387-42e5-8a02-2fd4a2e6cfdf&variant=large" alt="uploaded image" /></p>
<p>Schedule a demo <a href="https://cal.com/greenlite/greenlite-demo">here</a> to see how Greenlite can help you scale your compliance operations with AI instead of outsourced teams.</p>
<h3 id="benefits-of-greenlite"><strong>Benefits of Greenlite:</strong></h3>
<ol>
<li><strong>Higher quality, transparency and control of reviews</strong>: give your team better visibility and control of your AML operations.</li>
<li><strong>Dramatic savings</strong>: using automated systems instead of human-reviewers will unlock capacity for strategic priorities.</li>
<li><strong>Unblock growth</strong>: with near-instant compliance capacity, your team can focus on higher-priority initiatives, like license applications, complex investigations and scaling core systems.</li>
</ol>
<h3 id="who-are-we"><strong>Who are we?</strong></h3>
<p>We’re <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/jinalex/">Alex</a> and <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/lawrencewill/">Will</a>. </p>
<p>Will led product teams working on Facebook's anti-money laundering (AML) platform, combating financial crimes across payment, gaming and e-commerce use cases. He also built core compliance infrastructure at Paxos, a growth-staged fintech that powers over 10M crypto wallets globally. </p>
<p>Alex was an engineer and product manager at Dropbox. He was the first employee at Flixed where he led product development and built a programmatic content engine.</p>
<p>Together, we’re excited to help fintech compliance teams unlock unprecedented growth with AI.</p>
